text:
Nina: Heads-up — a recruiter reported several interviews this morning where the interviewer link loads but the scorecard is blank. looks like something dropped during last night's ATS schema migration.

Emma (People Ops): thanks. can you paste an interview id and the payload if available?

Nina: int_1132 is one. webhook payload shows \"scorecard_template\": \"\" and the interviewer email has no form link.

Integration Bot: webhook delivered event=interview.scheduled id=int_1132 status=200

Omar - Recruiting Ops: we've got 7 interviews with empty scorecard_template between 2024-06-20T23:00 and 2024-06-21T04:00. i've exported CSV to #people-ops-attachments.

Ravi - Eng: likely the template renamer we rolled. compat-layer attempted to translate template_id -> template_ref but apparently returned empty string for some legacy records. i'm investigating the mapping table.

Emma (People Ops): priority is to ensure interviewers can submit feedback today. Omar, can recruiting pick a conservative fallback template we can apply?

Omar - Recruiting Ops: yes, fallback = \"standard-interviewer-v1\". we prefer not to re-email candidates.

Ravi - Eng: ok. i'll run a targeted backfill script against the 7 rows in prod after a quick staging smoke. script will set scorecard_template=standard-interviewer-v1 and then trigger a resend of interviewer materials (email idempotent).

Nina: please keep the recruiter thread updated. they asked for an ETA ~1 hour.

Ravi - Eng: staging patch done. sample int_1132 now shows scorecard_template=standard-interviewer-v1 and interviewer email contains link. smoke tests pass. prepping prod job.

Integration Bot: deploy job ats-template-mapper v2.5 -> prod queued

Ravi - Eng: prod patch started at 2024-06-21T15:10Z job=job-9021. patched 7 interviews. triggered resend emails.

Omar - Recruiting Ops: confirmed interviewers received materials, recruiters notified. thanks.

Emma (People Ops): follow-ups: 1) add monitoring when compat mapping returns empty string, 2) add a one-click resend in the ATS UI, 3) update runbook with backfill steps and fallback template name. i'll own the runbook update.

Ravi - Eng: opened ticket RECR-940 for monitoring + tests. also adding a small unit test to catch empty-mapping cases.

Nina: great, closing this thread unless anyone sees more missing forms. :white_check_mark:
